# Code of Conduct

MyNet is a small open-source homelab project. The community is small and friendly, and we want to keep it that way.

## Expected behaviour

When participating in this project — whether that's opening issues, commenting on pull requests, joining discussions, or contributing code — please:

- Be respectful and kind to other contributors. Assume good intent.
- Keep feedback constructive and focused on the work, not the person.
- Be patient with people new to the project, the technology, or open source in general.
- Help others succeed where you can; ask for help where you need it.
- Respect different viewpoints and experiences, even when you disagree.

## Not acceptable

Behaviour that disrespects, demeans, or excludes other contributors is not welcome. This includes any form of personal attack, discrimination, or harassment — whether in issues, pull requests, discussions, commit messages, or any other project space.

The maintainer's judgement is final on what falls into this category.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces — the GitHub repository, issues, discussions, pull requests, commit messages, and any other communication tied to the project.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behaviour that breaks this Code of Conduct:

- For a public issue or comment, you can flag it directly to the maintainer by mentioning **@StableFlux** on the relevant thread.
- For something private or sensitive, contact the maintainer directly through GitHub by [opening a private security advisory](https://github.com/StableFlux/MyNet/security/advisories/new) — that channel works for Code of Conduct concerns as well as security issues, and the maintainer is the only person who sees it.

All reports will be reviewed in good faith and treated with discretion. The reporter's identity will not be shared outside the maintainer's review without consent.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may take any action they consider appropriate, ranging from a private word, to editing or removing comments, to blocking a contributor from the project. Decisions are at the maintainer's discretion.

## Acknowledgement

This Code of Conduct is original to MyNet but draws on patterns common across open-source communities, including the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
